rationale: The original downside continuation thesis remains fully intact: SKM has pushed through the earlier session low of $27.32 to print a new low at $27.27 and is currently consolidating at the bottom of its range ($27.29–$27.31) well below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($27.43) and session VWAP ($27.98).
